verified_claims_banked.spice_interface_contract: Basilisk SpiceInterface (gravBodyFactory.createSpiceInterface) wraps NASA NAIF CSPICE (furnsh_c / spkezr_c) to load .bsp, .tls, and .tpc kernels and publish SpicePlanetStateMsgPayload (PositionVector in m, VelocityVector in m/s, J20002Pfix attitude DCM, J20002Pfix_dot).
m7_budget_closure_invariant_7_criteria: 1. Single-Frame Truth: every cross-subsystem state vector carries an explicit coordinate frame tag (J2000 inertial or body-fixed IAU with explicit DCM on the seam).
2. Three-Clock Law: no subsystem advances its own epoch past a synchronization boundary without publishing its state delta to the seam.
3. Bounded Stride Ratio: the ratio of fast steps to slow steps per synchronization window is an explicit integer or rational constant.
4. Residual Reporting: every synchronization window closes with a scalar residual in physical units (m, m/s, rad, s, J, kg).
5. Seam-Only Coupling: subsystems never mutate each other's internal state directly; all coupling flows through the message seam.
6. Deterministic Replay: given the same seed, initial state, and kernel set, a window replays bit-for-bit identically on the same platform.
7. Graceful Degradation: when an input is out of range or a kernel is missing, the subsystem degrades to a documented fallback and surfaces a named residual rather than silent NaNs.
verified_claims_banked.unit_boundary_rule_2026_11_02_L1_L2: SPICE.jl returns state vectors in km and km/s whereas Basilisk SpicePlanetStateMsgPayload uses SI m and m/s. Scale positions and velocities by 1e3 in a single pure boundary function convert_spice_state_to_basilisk_si(raw_state_km), carry the IAU frame DCM separately, and verify against a Basilisk-generated state at the same epoch. Never conflate the 1e3 SI unit conversion factor with propulsion thrust scaling (pro_factor) or accelFactor.
